headline: Mooring Shifts as Weathered Expanse Sees Fresh Flips
war_summary: Since the evening edition the wire quickens in the Weathered Expanse with two changes in two hours and thirty-five in the day around Crow's Nest, Frostmarch and Wightwalk, latest at 21:10, holdings now three Warden, five Colonial and one neutral with day losses above twelve thousand on each side and casualty rates still accelerating. Mooring County follows with three changes in two hours and thirty-five in the day around Gravekeeper's Holdfast, The Cut and Wiccwalk, latest at 20:10, now ten Warden to two Colonial with day losses near ten thousand a side. Stlican Shelf adds one change in two hours and eleven in the day around Fort Hoarfrost and The Pale House, latest at 19:55, now three Warden to six Colonial. New copy comes from Palantine Berm with three changes in the day at Leiri Hermanni, latest at 20:55, standing six Warden to one Colonial. Farranac Coast rests since 15:15 at Transient Valley, still eleven Colonial, and Stonecradle remains quiet since 09:16 despite seventeen day changes, while Callahans Passage and Nevish Line show heavy accelerating losses without a recorded flip.
